# Striim

> Striim is a real-time data integration and streaming platform enabling CDC, data pipelines, and analytics across cloud and on-premise environments.

Striim provides comprehensive solutions for real-time data movement, change data capture, and streaming analytics. The platform integrates with major cloud providers (AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure) and data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Microsoft Fabric) to enable AI-ready data pipelines and high-availability replication.

## Key Topics

- Real-time Data Integration
- Change Data Capture (CDC)
- Data Streaming
- Striim Cloud
- Data Pipelines
- Google Cloud
- AWS
- Microsoft Azure
- Snowflake
- Databricks
- BigQuery
- Microsoft Fabric
- AI/ML
- Schema Evolution
- High Availability

## Core Products

- [Striim Platform](https://www.striim.com/striim-platform): On-premise real-time data integration and analytics platform
- [Striim Cloud](https://www.striim.com/striim-cloud): SaaS platform for scalable real-time data integration and streaming
- [Striim Developer](https://www.striim.com/striim-developer): Developer sandbox with connectors, AI agents, and certification programs
- [Validata](https://www.striim.com/validata): Data validation and reconciliation product for ensuring data quality

## Cloud & Data Warehouse Integrations

- [Striim for Snowflake](https://www.striim.com/snowflake): Managed SaaS solution for real-time Snowflake data integration
- [Striim for BigQuery](https://www.striim.com/bigquery): Real-time data streaming integration for Google BigQuery
- [Databricks and Striim](https://www.striim.com/databricks): Integration with Databricks for real-time data pipelines and lakehouse
- [Striim for Microsoft Fabric](https://www.striim.com/microsoft-fabric): SQL2Fabric-X for real-time Microsoft Fabric data replication

## Cloud Platform Integrations

- [Striim on AWS](https://www.striim.com/aws): Integration with AWS services: S3, Kinesis, Redshift, MSK, RDS
- [Google Cloud and Striim](https://www.striim.com/google-cloud): Real-time pipelines with Google Cloud and BigQuery
- [Striim and Microsoft Azure](https://www.striim.com/microsoft-azure): Integration with Azure, Fabric, and Synapse Analytics

## Capabilities & Features

- [Streaming Integration](https://www.striim.com/streaming-integration): Real-time data movement with CDC, Kafka, and streaming technologies
- [High Availability](https://www.striim.com/high-availability): Striim Cloud Mission Critical for high-availability data replication
- [Striim Cloud Security](https://www.striim.com/striim-cloud-security): Security features: SAML, encryption, RBAC, TLS 1.3
- [AI and Machine Learning Solutions](https://www.striim.com/striim-ai-ml): AI/ML solutions for real-time AI-ready data pipelines

## Industry Solutions

- [Financial Services](https://www.striim.com/striim-financial-services): Solutions for KYC, AML, fraud detection, and regulatory compliance
- [Retail and CPG](https://www.striim.com/retail-and-cpg): Real-time solutions for inventory, personalization, and fraud detection
